findings.original: If either implementation diverges from the agreed behaviour, its run fails. The fake stays trustworthy, so the 400 fast tests stay meaningful.
findings.correction: If either implementation diverges on an exercised case with an adequate assertion, that check fails. This supplies evidence for the covered contract, not proof that all behaviour matches.
findings.reason: A finite contract suite cannot guarantee every divergence detected.
